text:
Nina Patel: Heads up — spotted two NetSuite invoices with the same external_id (stripe invoice inv_78abc / human ref 2026-00045) created minutes apart. Memos differ (one shows "promo credit applied"). Anyone seen this?
Devin Chen: digging into the webhook delivery; stripe shows two deliveries/retries for the same event around 10:02:03/10:02:05. Payloads look the same except the invoice.description/memo field changed in one.
Devin Chen: ```
Delivery attempts:
- evt_abc123 id=evt_abc123 time=2026-03-01T10:02:03Z status=delivered
- evt_def456 id=evt_def456 time=2026-03-01T10:02:05Z status=delivered (retry)
payload: invoice.id=inv_78abc invoice.number=2026-00045 metadata:{promo=true} description differs
```
finance-bot: NetSuite connector: created Invoice 2026-00045 (NS-54321) at 2026-03-01T10:02:06Z
finance-bot: NetSuite connector: created Invoice 2026-00045 (NS-54322) at 2026-03-01T10:02:07Z
Samir Gupta: Connector should be idempotent by stripe.event.id or invoice.external_id. Looks like the NS connector currently uses a payload hash that changed when description changed -> created a new invoice.
Leo Ortiz: Yup — I've seen this pattern: if any of the fields we include in the de-dupe hash change, the connector treats it as a new record. Bug: de-dupe key should be invoice.external_id + stripe.event.id fallback.
Nina Patel: Do we know if customers were emailed the duplicate? CS?
Maya Li: One of the duplicates was emailed; CS has a ticket from the customer about duplicate invoice on the portal.
Devin Chen: Short-term fix we can do: persist stripe.event.id (evt_abc123) in NS mapping and skip create if seen. That will stop new dupes. Need to patch connector.
Samir Gupta: Agreed. Plan suggestion:
1) Pause ns-push for the finance org for ~15m.
2) Run a reconcile job to find duplicates by external_id (invoice.number) created in last 24h.
3) For duplicates: choose canonical invoice (earliest created), void/credit the duplicates, add audit note + link to stripe events.
4) Backfill NS id into stripe metadata for canonical mapping.
Nina Patel: @Devin @Samir please coordinate with CS before pausing — we need messaging for affected customers.
Devin Chen: Will sync with CS now. ETA ~30m. I'll also open PR with the guard to skip on seen stripe.event.id.
Leo Ortiz: I'll scan the daily export to ensure reporting isn't affected.
finance-bot: Reconcile job (preview) found 14 potential duplicate invoice groups in last 2 hours.
Nina Patel: OK let's proceed with pause after CS ack. @Devin @Samir
Devin Chen: :white_check_mark: Paused ns-push for finance org at 2026-03-01T10:30:00Z. Starting reconcile job now.
Samir Gupta: I'll draft the auto-merge script and post commands in #eng-ops. Will include dry-run first.
Nina Patel: Thanks all. Please follow up with a short postmortem once we have root cause and fix merged.
Maya Li: Noted — CS will use the template and reach out to affected customers once duplicates are voided.
